one_sentence_what_octus_does: Octus helps regulated businesses with licensing, compliance, legal and corporate structure, private-client ownership issues, remediation when things are blocked, and the specialist network those programmes need.

taxonomy.six_solutions_role: Website implementation reference only — not controlling commercial taxonomy

public_areas.name: Regulatory Structuring
public_areas.one_sentence: Jurisdiction fit, licensing pathways and regulatory programmes for regulated operations.

public_areas.name: Compliance & Risk
public_areas.one_sentence: Compliance frameworks, AML/KYC, DPO and controls that can run under real scrutiny.

public_areas.name: Legal & Structural Architecture
public_areas.one_sentence: Legal and contractual frameworks for regulated operations, coordinated with counsel where needed.

public_areas.name: Corporate Structuring
public_areas.one_sentence: Companies, holdings and group design for onshore, offshore and cross-border regulated operations.

public_areas.name: Private Clients
public_areas.one_sentence: Personal and ownership structuring for founders, UBOs, executives and families tied to regulated operations.
public_areas.naming_note: Original website module title was Ownership & UBO; page and design also use Private Clients. Rubio mandate keeps Private Clients as a public area.

public_areas.name: Remediation & Readiness
public_areas.one_sentence: Diagnosis and fix when licensing, banking, compliance, corporate, finance or operations are already blocked or failing.
public_areas.naming_note: Original public module title was Audit & Readiness. Rubio mandate preserves Remediation as the public area meaning. Exact label needs Rubio confirmation: Audit & Readiness vs Remediation & Readiness.

public_areas.name: International Hub
public_areas.one_sentence: Finding, connecting and coordinating the banks, PSPs, CSPs, labs, counsel and other specialists a regulated operation needs.
public_areas.naming_note: Recovered original approved public name: International Hub (git what-we-do; legacy /international-hub). Not Octus Hub or Networking.

services.name: Licensing strategy and pathway design
services.one_sentence: We design the licensing pathway and sequence before filings start.
services.typical_client_need: Entering a regulated market or changing venue without a clear filing path.

services.name: iGaming licensing programme
services.one_sentence: We run iGaming licensing as a full programme, not a standalone filing.
services.typical_client_need: Operator needs a gaming licence path coordinated with corporate, compliance and banking.

services.name: Fintech, EMI and crypto licensing
services.one_sentence: We treat fintech and payments authorisation as an operable stack, not a paper exercise.
services.typical_client_need: EMI/PI or related authorisation without a workable operating setup.

services.name: Brazil SPA / MF regulatory support
services.one_sentence: We coordinate Brazil-facing regulatory workstreams for betting and related frameworks.
services.typical_client_need: Entering or adapting to Brazil’s national betting framework.

services.name: Jurisdiction selection and risk mapping
services.one_sentence: We compare venue options for fit, timeline, banking access and operational risk.
services.typical_client_need: Choosing between candidate venues before committing to a filing path.

services.name: AML / KYC / CDD frameworks
services.one_sentence: We build identification, monitoring and due diligence frameworks that banks and regulators can test.
services.typical_client_need: Paper AML that fails under bank or regulator questions.

services.name: Compliance-as-a-Service
services.one_sentence: We operate the compliance function inside the business as an ongoing service.
services.typical_client_need: Need for embedded compliance ownership, not one-off policies.

services.name: DPO-as-a-Service
services.one_sentence: We operate the DPO role for LGPD and GDPR contexts as a working function.
services.typical_client_need: Privacy role exists on paper but does not operate.

services.name: Internal controls and governance
services.one_sentence: We design controls and decision rights that run in day-to-day operations.
services.typical_client_need: Banks or auditors cannot test how decisions and evidence actually work.

services.name: Certification and lab readiness
services.one_sentence: We prepare evidence and readiness for laboratory and formal external review.
services.typical_client_need: GLI or similar review approaching without a working evidence pack.
services.claim_fence: Octus is not the laboratory; no certification promise

services.name: Policies and due diligence packs
services.one_sentence: We produce policy suites and due diligence packs aligned to how the operation actually runs.
services.typical_client_need: Policies exist but do not match real flows.

services.name: Contractual architecture
services.one_sentence: We design contract frameworks across group, operator and commercial layers.
services.typical_client_need: Contracts do not match how the business actually runs.

services.name: Multi-jurisdiction legal frameworks
services.one_sentence: We coordinate legal coherence across jurisdictions with independent counsel where required.
services.typical_client_need: Multi-venue group needs one clear legal map.

services.name: Counsel coordination
services.one_sentence: We act as the execution counterpart that sequences legal work with licensing, corporate and compliance programmes.
services.typical_client_need: Operators and counsel need a single coordinating counterpart.

services.name: Legal opinions and certifications support
services.one_sentence: We support legal opinions and related certification paperwork as part of a regulated programme.
services.typical_client_need: Opinion or certification support required for licence or banking file.

services.name: Entity and holding architecture
services.one_sentence: We design holdings and group structures that stay coherent under licence and bank scrutiny.
services.typical_client_need: Ownership chart will not survive licence or bank review.

services.name: Company formation
services.one_sentence: We open entities inside a designed architecture — not as a standalone incorporation shop.
services.typical_client_need: Entities needed for licence and banking fit.

services.name: Cross-border structuring
services.one_sentence: We design multi-venue organisation so the group holds together across jurisdictions.
services.typical_client_need: Expansion or multi-venue group without a coherent structure.

services.name: Corporate reorganisation
services.one_sentence: We reorganise when the current structure blocks licensing, banking or expansion.
services.typical_client_need: Existing structure is the blocker.

services.name: Banking readiness
services.one_sentence: We prepare ownership, documentation and compliance posture for real banking conversations. No promised accounts.
services.typical_client_need: Licensed or near-licensed operator stuck in bank or PSP rejection loops.

services.name: Accounting and finance coordination
services.one_sentence: We sell and coordinate accounting and finance programmes under the Octus relationship.
services.typical_client_need: Regulated group needs accounting and finance run without managing multiple vendor relationships.

services.name: Corporate tax planning
services.one_sentence: We coordinate corporate tax planning for regulated groups under the Octus relationship.
services.typical_client_need: Corporate tax planning required as part of structure or expansion.
services.claim_fence: Partner brands not named publicly; no outcome guarantees

services.name: Ownership and UBO architecture
services.one_sentence: We structure ownership and UBO layers for the individuals behind regulated operations.
services.typical_client_need: Beneficial owners need disclosure readiness and structural clarity.

services.name: Personal holding and asset organisation
services.one_sentence: We organise personal holdings and separate personal assets from operational assets where needed.
services.typical_client_need: Founders mix personal and operational assets in ways that fail scrutiny.

services.name: Residency and personal international structuring
services.one_sentence: We coordinate residency and personal international structuring tied to regulated operations.
services.typical_client_need: Founder or UBO needs residency or personal structure aligned to the business.
services.capacity_note: Controlled commercial; not a citizenship shop

services.name: Personal banking and individual KYC readiness
services.one_sentence: We prepare individuals for personal banking and KYC scrutiny linked to regulated operations.
services.typical_client_need: UBO or executive blocked in personal banking because the file is incomplete.

services.name: Personal tax coordination
services.one_sentence: We coordinate personal tax work for founders and UBOs under the Octus relationship.
services.typical_client_need: IRPF or personal tax planning connected to the operating structure.

services.name: Crisis entry and structural assessment
services.one_sentence: A single intake when the operation is blocked, delayed, rejected or failing.
services.typical_client_need: Live failure under regulatory or banking pressure.

services.name: Licensing delay remediation
services.one_sentence: We unblock stalled or conditioned licensing by fixing the structural causes.
services.typical_client_need: Licence delayed or conditioned with repeated failed filings.

services.name: Banking or compliance gap remediation
services.one_sentence: We remediate when banking rejection or compliance gaps are the live constraint.
services.typical_client_need: Active bank rejection or compliance scrutiny.
mapped_internal_skus: banking + compliance SKUs under crisis programmes

services.name: Audit and readiness remediation
services.one_sentence: We close evidence and readiness gaps when formal review is imminent or already failing.
services.typical_client_need: Audit or certification review under pressure.

services.name: Financial infrastructure remediation
services.one_sentence: When banking or payment infrastructure has already failed, we sequence recovery with the right layers.
services.typical_client_need: Banking or PSP stack already broken.

services.name: Tax and finance problem remediation
services.one_sentence: We coordinate tax recovery and finance problem programmes when the live issue is already a blockage.
services.typical_client_need: Tax debt, recovery or finance blockage affecting operations.
services.claim_fence: No guaranteed recovery outcomes; partner brands not named

services.name: Market entry coordination
services.one_sentence: We coordinate entry into a new regulated market as one sequenced programme.
services.typical_client_need: Expansion treated as a commercial decision without a working programme.

services.name: Bank and PSP introductions
services.one_sentence: We identify and coordinate relevant banks and PSPs for the operation’s risk profile.
services.typical_client_need: Operator cannot find workable banking or payment partners.
services.claim_fence: No promised onboarding; no SLA on introductions

services.name: Payment and PSP architecture
services.one_sentence: We design payment and PSP options matched to markets, settlement needs and risk.
services.typical_client_need: Payment stack incompatible with risk profile.

services.name: CSP, local director and formation partners
services.one_sentence: We connect and coordinate CSPs, local directors and formation partners required by the venue.
services.typical_client_need: Venue requires local presence or CSP support the client cannot source alone.

services.name: Lab, certification and specialist network coordination
services.one_sentence: We identify and coordinate laboratories, certification providers and other specialists the programme needs.
services.typical_client_need: Programme depends on labs, KYC/AML vendors, tech platforms or other specialists.
services.claim_fence: No fixed public SLA; Octus is not the laboratory

services.name: Counsel and tax specialist coordination
services.one_sentence: We identify and coordinate legal counsel and tax specialists required for the matter.
services.typical_client_need: Matter needs local counsel or tax specialists under one Octus relationship.
